info.name: Azure Networking Azure Virtual Networks API

description.content:
Manage Azure Virtual Networks (VNets) including subnets, peering, and network configurations. Virtual Networks enable Azure resources to securely communicate with each other, the internet, and on-premises networks. This API provides operations for creating, updating, deleting, and listing virtual networks within Azure subscriptions and resource groups.
